raw.title: fix: address review findings on the xpath version advisory
raw.body:
fix: address review findings on the xpath version advisory

Fresh review of 2517b49 found two issues. First, the pre-1.1
omitted-version wording told every site to declare a Criterion
Expression Type Object, but that object applies only to criteria -
Arazzo 1.0.x has no Selector Object or targetSelectorType vocabulary at
all, so a 1.0.x selector-site advisory was recommending an object that
neither applies nor exists there. The advisory now carries the site
(criterion vs selector, declared on the existing ExpressionTypeRules
consts): pre-1.1 criterion advisories keep the Criterion Expression
Type Object name and the XML Path Language 3.1 default, while pre-1.1
selector/replacement advisories name no versioning object and claim no
spec default, stating only the rejection and the xpath-10 remedy. New
test pins a 1.0.1 document with output-selector and targetSelectorType
sites.

Second, the new unsupportedXpathVersion kind was missing from the
frozen kind-names contract test, the canonical enumeration guarding the
--json name strings; the pair is added in enum order.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
